resources.string: Displays a floating dot overlay to provide one-handed shortcuts and capture screenshots without collecting screen content or personal data.
Actions for each gesture and timing
A fast, private floating shortcut dot that places essential system actions and screenshot captures right under your thumb.

Dotap uses Android\'s AccessibilityService API solely to:\n• Display the floating shortcut dot above other applications.\n• Perform global actions you trigger, such as taking screenshots, going Home, Back, or opening Notifications.
• Dotap NEVER reads, captures, or transmits your screen content, typed text, or personal information.\n• Dotap operates entirely offline with zero network permissions.
Service enabled but not connected. Try toggling it off and on in Settings.

If the Accessibility switch is grayed out on Android 13 or later:

1. Tap "Open App Info" below.
2. Tap the three dots (⋮) in the top-right corner.
3. Tap "Allow restricted settings" and verify your PIN or fingerprint.
4. Return here and tap "Enable in Accessibility Settings".
Prevent system from stopping floating dot in background
Some manufacturers aggressively close background overlay apps. Follow the steps below for your device to ensure Dotap stays active.

1. Open Settings > Apps > Manage apps > Dotap.
2. Turn ON "Autostart".
3. Tap "Battery saver" and select "No restrictions".
4. Lock Dotap in the Recents screen.
1. Open Settings > Apps > Dotap > Battery.\n2. Select \"Unrestricted\".\n3. Open Settings > Battery and device care > Battery > Background usage limits > Never sleeping apps, then add Dotap.
1. Open Settings > Battery > App Battery Management > Dotap.\n2. Enable \"Allow background activity\" and \"Allow auto-launch\".\n3. Lock Dotap in the Recents screen.

1. Open Settings > Battery > Background power consumption management.\n2. Find Dotap and select \"High background power consumption\" or \"Don\'t restrict\".\n3. Enable Autostart in Permissions management.
1. Open Settings > Battery > App launch.\n2. Turn OFF \"Manage automatically\" for Dotap.\n3. Turn ON \"Auto-launch\", \"Secondary launch\", and \"Run in background\".
1. Open Settings > Apps > Dotap > App battery usage.\n2. Select \"Unrestricted\" or disable battery optimization.\n3. Ensure background usage is permitted.
